'''Mon Calamari''', sometimes referred to as '''Mon Calamarian''' or '''Mon Cal''', was the official language of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] species. Mon Calamaris, however, learned to speak both Mon Calamarian and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] since they were a part of the galactic community.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Many also learned to speak [[Quarrenese/Legends|Quarrenese]]. Similarly, Mon Calamari was learned by many [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
